command:
set -Eeuo pipefail
echo "STEP: backup fstab"
sudo -n cp -a /etc/fstab /etc/fstab.bak.$(date +%s)

echo "STEP: ensure /tmp fstab entry"
if grep -qE '^\S+\s+/tmp\s' /etc/fstab; then
  echo "existing /tmp entry found, updating options"
  sudo -n sed -i -E 's|^(\S+)\s+/tmp\s+(\S+)\s+(\S+)\s+(.*)$|\1 /tmp \2 defaults,rw,nosuid,nodev,noexec,relatime \4|' /etc/fstab
else
  echo "tmpfs /tmp tmpfs defaults,rw,nosuid,nodev,noexec,relatime 0 0" | sudo -n tee -a /etc/fstab >/dev/null
fi

echo "STEP: ensure /dev/shm fstab entry"
if grep -qE '^\S+\s+/dev/shm\s' /etc/fstab; then
  echo "existing /dev/shm entry found, updating options"
  sudo -n sed -i -E 's|^(\S+)\s+/dev/shm\s+(\S+)\s+(\S+)\s+(.*)$|\1 /dev/shm \2 defaults,rw,nosuid,nodev,noexec,relatime \4|' /etc/fstab
else
  echo "tmpfs /dev/shm tmpfs defaults,rw,nosuid,nodev,noexec,relatime 0 0" | sudo -n tee -a /etc/fstab >/dev/null
fi

echo "STEP: resulting fstab"
cat /etc/fstab

echo "STEP: daemon-reload"
sudo -n systemctl daemon-reload

echo "STEP: enable+start tmp.mount"
sudo -n systemctl enable tmp.mount
sudo -n systemctl start tmp.mount

echo "STEP: remount /dev/shm with new options"
sudo -n mount -o remount /dev/shm

echo "STEP: verify /tmp"
findmnt /tmp

echo "STEP: verify /dev/shm"
findmnt /dev/shm

echo "STEP: functional check - noexec on /tmp"
sudo -n sh -c 'printf "#!/bin/sh\necho should-not-run\n" > /tmp/exectest.sh; chmod +x /tmp/exectest.sh'
if /tmp/exectest.sh 2>/tmp/exectest.err; then
  echo "FAIL: /tmp allowed execution"
else
  echo "OK: /tmp blocked execution"; cat /tmp/exectest.err
fi

echo "STEP: functional check - noexec on /dev/shm"
sudo -n sh -c 'printf "#!/bin/sh\necho should-not-run\n" > /dev/shm/exectest.sh; chmod +x /dev/shm/exectest.sh'
if /dev/shm/exectest.sh 2>/dev/shm/exectest.err; then
  echo "FAIL: /dev/shm allowed execution"
else
  echo "OK: /dev/shm blocked execution"; cat /dev/shm/exectest.err
fi

echo "STEP: cleanup test files"
sudo -n rm -f /tmp/exectest.sh /tmp/exectest.err /dev/shm/exectest.sh /dev/shm/exectest.err
